summary: Source-controlled proto3 write service contracts and validation registry for backbone messenger, mail, social, and community write RPCs.
claim_boundary: Source contract and deterministic validation only. This slice adds hand-authored proto3 files for the implemented write RPC names and a Rust validator that embeds and checks them. It does not run protoc/prost/tonic, generate Rust stubs, serialize protobuf binary payloads, start a gRPC server/client, contact a broker, or prove transport delivery.

source_basis.use: Official Protocol Buffers proto3 language specification for syntax/package/field/message/service/RPC proto-file structure.

facets.F1_simplicity: Proto files remain source-controlled under specs/proto/backbone while the validator is a small dependency-free kernel that performs deterministic string/token checks.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Stable proto package/service/RPC contracts and common tenant/principal/idempotency/policy/audit metadata prepare future generated stubs and service gateways for multi-tenant cloud integration without claiming runtime traffic.
facets.F3_adversarial: Negative tests reject missing proto3 syntax, missing RPC declarations, missing common metadata fields, and forbidden proto2 required-field usage.
facets.F4_api_contract: The registry exposes BackboneProtoContract, BackboneProtoRpc, BACKBONE_PROTO_CONTRACTS, validate_proto_contract, and validate_all_backbone_proto_contracts for future CI and generator entrypoints.
facets.F5_quality: Focused proto-contract tests plus the 43-package backbone check/test/clippy/fmt matrix, cargo-deny, license-policy, cargo-prefix, catalog/data-class known-blocker probes, parse/config validation, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F6_operations: CI path filters, GitHub Actions package matrices, and Jenkins BACKBONE_CARGO_PACKAGES include the proto-contract kernel so later proto contract changes exercise the same validation lane.
facets.F7_security_privacy: The proto contracts model identifier/reference metadata and encrypted envelope references; they do not add raw message/mail/post body content, secrets, broker URLs, database URLs, or principal credentials.
facets.F8_supply_chain: No third-party dependency is introduced; the new kernel uses include_str! and local validation logic only.
facets.F9_testing: Focused tests passed for 6 proto-contract unit tests and the broad backbone matrix passed 274 unit tests plus the existing ignored metrics adapter doctest.
facets.F10_ci_cd: GitHub Actions and all four Jenkinsfiles include the proto-contract kernel; this is static CI definition evidence and does not claim remote CI execution.
facets.F11_observability: Common audit_correlation_id, idempotency_key, and policy_decision_ref fields in each source contract preserve the metadata future runtime telemetry and audit correlation will need.
facets.F13_reversibility: The change is localized to proto source files, one dependency-free validation crate, catalog/CI task wiring, and evidence; reverting removes contract validation without changing runtime handlers.
